Systems Implementation & QA Playbooks

Posted September 29, 2025

Created comprehensive implementation checklists, quality assurance scripts, and standardized documentation to bring consistency and repeatability to software rollouts, lab environment provisioning, and technical deployment workflows across classroom and examination environments.

Project details

Defined structured testing gates, compatibility verification steps, and rollback procedures for each phase of software and system deployments, ensuring that new installations were validated against baseline requirements before being released to production or classroom environments.

Developed step-by-step QA scripts covering pre-deployment environment checks, installation verification, post-deployment functional testing, and user acceptance criteria, reducing the likelihood of configuration drift and inconsistent setups across multiple machines.

Aligned documentation standards with institutional procedures so that support staff and instructors could execute repeatable installations independently, following consistent handoff checklists that captured configuration details, version information, and known-issue workarounds.

Maintained a living library of deployment playbooks covering common scenarios — including development tool installation (Eclipse, VS Code, MySQL), operating system configuration, virtual machine setup, and network service provisioning — with version tracking to keep procedures current as software updates were released.

Work Context: Across FUTA (2017–2023) and Pures College (2024–2025), these implementation and QA playbooks were used to stabilize rollouts and reduce configuration drift across teams.

Current Implementation: I continue maintaining the same checklist-first model in personal projects to keep deployments repeatable and auditable.

Case study

Project Summary

Created comprehensive implementation checklists, quality assurance scripts, and standardized documentation to bring consistency and repeatability to software rollouts, lab environment provisioning, and technical deployment workflows across classroom and examination environments.

Work Context

Across FUTA (Systems & Data Analyst / System Programmer, 2017–2023) and Pures College (IT Systems Support and Computer Instructor, 2024–2025), these playbooks stabilized rollouts and reduced configuration drift across teams. Testing gates, compatibility checks, and rollback procedures were defined for each deployment phase.

Current Implementation

I continue maintaining the same checklist-first model in personal projects to keep deployments repeatable and auditable, with version-tracked playbooks covering common installation and configuration scenarios.

Results and Impact

  • Deployments standardized: 30+
  • Setup time improvement: 15% faster
  • Playbooks maintained: 6 (install, QA, rollback, docs, onboarding, reset)

Deliverables

  • Step-by-step QA scripts covering pre-deployment checks, installation verification, and post-deployment testing
  • Handoff checklists capturing configuration details, version information, and known-issue workarounds
  • Living library of deployment playbooks for development tools, OS configuration, VM setup, and network services

Technical Notes

  • Playbook scope: Eclipse, VS Code, MySQL installation; OS configuration; VM setup; network service provisioning.
  • Each playbook includes version tracking to stay current with software updates.
  • Rollback procedures are documented alongside forward deployment steps.
